$comment: Journeys (lib/journeys.js): messages sent on their own when something happens — someone creates an account, orders, has an order delivered, or leaves a cart — or to an audience enrolled by hand, as a series of steps each waiting a while after the one before. Each step goes by email, SMS or a note in the shopper's account (the channels of lib/seed/campaigns.json), only to people with a live grant for marketing (checked when they enter and again before each message), and carries the unsubscribe link; withdrawing stops every journey for that person. An event a journey names as its exit takes the person out (an order ends an abandoned-cart journey). Nobody gets more than maxPerDay journey messages in a day; a message over the cap waits for the next day. Opens (email) and clicks (every channel) are counted by lib/campaigns.js track. A store sets its own values in settings journeys.<key>.

cart.abandoned.label: Someone leaves items in their cart

audience.label: People enrolled by hand from an audience
